title: validate_chain: cycle detection + trust-anchor validity filter — keep
description: cert.rs validate_chain uses a HashSet to detect cycles in the certificate bag, and filters trust anchors by validity period before signature verification. A contributor might suggest removing the cycle check as 'edge case'. It prevents infinite loops on adversarially constructed bags. The trust-anchor validity filter implements RFC 5280 §6.1.3(a)(1) — an expired root must not validate a still-valid EE cert.
close_reason: Decision record — no code change needed
